x-ectwin.runs_in: Commons job jev-triage-national, triggered by Pub/Sub on a new SITREP or ECU 911 batch
x-ectwin.data_class_rule: ECU 911 / SNGR operational narratives. DLP pseudonymisation is mandatory; send to the TypeSafe backend only after zero-data-retention (enterprise) terms and the DPA review are signed. Until then route to open_weight or to gemini_adapter in Agent Platform mode (to confirm).

placeholders.narrative: Pseudonymised free-text narrative, verbatim Spanish, max 3,000 characters
placeholders.operator_code: Existing ECU 911 or SNGR event code as recorded by the operator
placeholders.operator_code_label: Human-readable label of operator_code from the source code list
placeholders.reported_place: Place text as recorded (province, canton, parish or locality); DPA resolution happens separately in B3

notes: Numbers of affected people are never asked of Jev; code extracts them with a regex, or Gemini proposes candidates and Jev selects (select, do not generate).
Event classes to be aligned with the SNGR event taxonomy used in COE2 and EVENTOS_X_LLUVIAS (to confirm with SNGR).
x-ectwin.output: commons_internal.incident_records (typed fields; the narrative text is removed after 90 days, docs/13 section 2.10)

sngr_event.instructions: Which event class best describes what `narrative` reports?

criteria.inundacion: Flooding of land, streets or homes, including river overflow
criteria.colapso_estructural: Collapse of a house, wall or other structure
criteria.socavamiento_via: Road or embankment undermined or washed out
criteria.no_hidrometeorologico: Not a weather-, water- or fire-related event (for example traffic, crime or medical)

asset_bridge.instructions: Does `narrative` report damage to, or closure of, a bridge?

asset_road.instructions: Does `narrative` report a road blocked, cut, flooded or damaged?

asset_health.instructions: Does `narrative` report a hospital, health centre or clinic affected or cut off?

asset_school.instructions: Does `narrative` report a school or educational unit affected or used as a shelter?

asset_water.instructions: Does `narrative` report drinking-water, sewer or drainage systems affected?

needs_rescue.instructions: Does `narrative` request or describe rescue or evacuation of people?

affected_people_stated.instructions: Does `narrative` state a number of affected, displaced, injured or dead people or families?
